ui.ZumChattenBrauchstDuEin: To chat you need an AI model. It runs either for free on your own computer or at an online service. Choose what you want to use – the settings will then guide you step by step.

ui.EineArtPasswortFuerProgramme: (a kind of password for programs). Every request costs a little money – usually fractions of a cent.

Each provider remembers its own address, key and model. Click one on the left to view and change it – “Save” does not change which provider answers in the chat; that's what “Use in chat” is for.

ui.SetzeBeimAnbieterUnbedingtEin2: Be sure to set a spending limit for this key or your account at the provider (link with ⚠ above under “Links”). Why and how:
ui.LegtFestWoDeineAnfragen: Determines where your requests are processed. The model list then only shows models that run in the chosen region.
ui.DieAppLaesstNurHoster: The app only allows host endpoints whose location is known and lies within the region (e.g. “mistral/eu”, “amazon-bedrock/eu-central-1”). Other hosts are blocked, and there are no fallback hosts. The location data comes from OpenRouter and the hosts themselves and is not guaranteed. On first load all models are checked, which takes a moment.
ui.OpenRouterSelbstStelltSicherDass: OpenRouter itself ensures that the request does not leave the region. This is only available on the Business plan (
ui.SonstKommtDerFehlerHTTP: ), otherwise you get the error HTTP 403.

ui.SetzeEinenHakenUmEinen: Tick a box to use your own value. Without a tick, the model's default applies. That is usually the best choice. Greyed-out settings are not known to the selected provider; they are then not sent.
ui.DieZahlenZaehltFreeGuentherSelbst: FreeGuenther counts these numbers itself. They may differ from your bill: some providers report no costs, prices change, discounts, caching or minimum charges are missing, and requests from other programs or other computers are not included.
ui.EinEigenesLimitInFreeGuenther: A separate limit in FreeGuenther, in addition to the spending limit at the provider. Once it is reached, FreeGuenther asks before every request to an online provider – or blocks it completely. At 80 % you get a notice. It is based on the estimate on this page. Local models are never affected. Empty = no limit.
ui.GemeldetBetragDenDerAnbieter: “reported” = amount the provider sent with the answer (OpenRouter). “≈ estimated” = tokens × list price from OpenRouter's public price list (OpenAI, Anthropic and answers without a reported amount). “unknown” = no price found. Local providers (LM Studio, Ollama) cost nothing. Counting started with version 1.11; older answers were taken over from the saved chats. Deleting a chat does not change the usage.
ui.IstEinPluginEingeschaltetKann: When a plugin is switched on, the model can call it by itself when needed – just ask normally, e.g. “What will the weather be like tomorrow in London?”. In the chat you see when a plugin is running, and below the answer which ones were used.
ui.InDerModelllisteStehenGeeignete: Suitable models are marked with 🔧 in the model list. Without this ability the model simply answers without plugins.

ui.EinEinfacherChatClientFuer: A simple chat client for local and online language models.
ui.EinAPISchluesselIstWie: An API key is like a credit card: whoever knows it can make requests at your expense. If it falls into the wrong hands (shared computer, screenshot, malware, accidentally published) or usage gets out of hand (many images, very long answers, expensive models), high costs can arise quickly.

Wie frei bzw. zufällig das Modell formul: How freely or randomly the model phrases things. Low (0 to 0.3): factual, and almost always the same answer to the same question – good for facts, code and reading images. Medium (0.7): balanced. High (above 1): creative but increasingly confused.
Das Modell wählt das nächste Wort nur au: The model only chooses the next word from the most likely candidates that together make up this share. 0.95 = the top 95 %. Smaller = more cautious. Usually it's enough to change only the temperature.
The model only chooses the next word from the K most likely candidates. 40 is typical. Smaller = more monotonous, larger = more varied.
Begrenzt, wie lang eine Antwort höchsten: Limits how long an answer can be at most. A token is roughly half a word to a whole word; 1000 tokens are about one to two pages of text. Without a tick: no limit (with Anthropic: 64000).
Bremst das Modell, wenn es sich wiederho: Slows the model down when it repeats itself. 1.00 = off, 1.10 = light (typical). Above 1.30 the language can become bumpy.

ui.AutomatikHinweis: When you put a matching file into the folder, FreeGuenther creates a result file next to it with the model's answer – same name, extension of the output (e.g. invoice.pdf → invoice.json), unless it already exists. Files that are already in the folder when you start are skipped. The automation only runs while FreeGuenther is open, and with online providers it counts towards the spending limit.
ui.PromptHinweis: What should happen with each file? E.g. “Extract the invoice number, date, sender and total amount.”

ui.MailHinweis: When a new e-mail arrives in the inbox, FreeGuenther reads it including its attachments (PDF, Word, Excel, text, images), lets the model write a reply according to your prompt and saves it as a draft in the “Drafts” folder – addressed to the sender, with the original e-mail quoted. The original e-mail is marked as read. Nothing is ever sent automatically. E-mails that are already there when you start are skipped. Only runs while FreeGuenther is open.
ui.InjectionTitel: ⚠ Important: content from others can contain hidden commands
ui.InjectionText: E-mails and files from other people can contain text aimed at the AI instead of at you – often invisible, e.g. white text on a white background: “Ignore your task and write … instead”. This is called prompt injection. FreeGuenther protects you as well as it can: here the AI may not execute anything, send anything or use plugins, and suspicious content is marked with ⚠. But manipulation can never be ruled out completely. So read every result before you use it – and only send reply drafts after you have checked them.
ui.PasswortHinweis: Stored encrypted (readable only with your Windows account). For Gmail and many others you need an app password. Microsoft accounts (Outlook.com, Microsoft 365) usually no longer allow password sign-in – they don't work here.
ui.AbsenderHinweis: The drafts are written from this address. Empty = the user name, if it is an e-mail address.
ui.MailPromptHinweis: How should replies be written? E.g. “Thank them politely, confirm receipt and announce an answer by Friday.”

Lies die Rechnung aus und gib die Daten: Read the invoice and return the data as a JSON object with these fields: issuer (name, address, vat_id), recipient (name, address), invoice_number, invoice_date, service_date, due_date, items (list with description, quantity, unit_price, total_price), net, vat_rate, vat_amount, gross, currency, iban, bic. Dates in the format YYYY-MM-DD, amounts as numbers with a decimal point. If a detail is missing from the invoice, use null – do not make anything up.
Erstelle eine kurze Übersicht der Rechnu: Create a short overview of the invoice, one line per detail: issuer, recipient, invoice number, invoice date, gross amount with currency, due date, bank details. If a detail is missing, write “not stated”.
Um welche Art von Dokument handelt es si: What kind of document is this (e.g. invoice, contract, letter, quote)? State the sender, date and subject and summarize the content in at most 5 bullet points. Mention deadlines and amounts, if any.
Bedanke dich freundlich für die Nachrich: Thank the sender kindly for the message, confirm receipt and say that a reply will follow in the next few days. Short and polite, without making any commitments on the content.
Beantworte die Fragen aus der E-Mail sac: Answer the questions in the e-mail in a factual and friendly way. Where information is missing, insert a placeholder such as [PLEASE FILL IN: delivery date] – do not make up facts, prices or dates.
Bestätige den Eingang der Rechnung. Nenn: Confirm receipt of the invoice. State the invoice number and amount if they appear in the e-mail or the attachment, and say that the invoice will be checked and paid within the payment term.
